# directus_user (Data Source)

Reads a Directus user by id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the user to look up.

### Read-Only

- `appearance` (String) Appearance preference.
- `auth_provider` (String) Auth provider.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `email_notifications` (Boolean) Email notifications enabled.
- `external_identifier` (String) External identifier.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `language` (String) Preferred language.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `location` (String) Location.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Always null; passwords are never returned.
- `role` (String) Role UUID.
- `status` (String) Account status.
- `tags` (List of String) Freeform tags.
- `theme_dark` (String) Dark theme.
- `theme_light` (String) Light theme.
- `title` (String) Job title.
